India's Women's Cricket Team Secures Historic Lord's Test Victory

India's women's cricket team achieved a significant victory in the first-ever women's Test match held at Lord's against England. The win was marked by record-breaking attendance and individual performances, including a century by Yastika Bhatia. The team's success has been highlighted as a moment of evolution for women's cricket.
